description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, raising height of existing brick parapet, replacement of extract duct, air handling plant, installation of 5 roof mounted condensor units, provision of 4 new windows fronting Mayfield Avenue, internal alterations to restaurant at ground and basement level and the construction of a disabled person toilet to the rear of the existing premises, and conversion of three bedsits and a one bedroom flat on first and second floors to a three bedroomed flat.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, raising height of existing brick parapet, replacement of extract duct, replacement of an air handling plant, installation of 5 roof mounted condenser units, provision of 4 new windows fronting Mayfield Avenue, internal alterations to restaurant at ground and basement level and the construction of a disabled person toilet to the rear of the existing premises, and conversion of three bedsits and a one bedroom flat on first and second floors into a three bedroom flat, as shown on drawing numbers 479/S01 (Rev B), 479/S02 (Rev B), 479/S03 (Rev B) and 479/S04, received 14 August 2006 and 479/P01 (Rev C), 479/P02 (Rev C), 479/P03 (Rev D) and 479/P04 (Rev B),  received 10 October 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the development would not be detrimental to the character of the street scene and Chiswick Town Centre or the amenity of surrounding residential and commercial properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The noise levels from the proposed air extraction plant and roof mounted condenser units, should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor and the level of noise emitted from the proposed air extraction plant and roof mounted condenser units, shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq) when measured over any 24 hour period, from the nearest noise sensitive receptor.To ensure these levels are meet, the works detailed in the 'Environmental Noise Survey Report' (Ref: RF81937) prepared by Noise Solutions Limited, dated 31st January 2007, shall be carried out in full.

Condition : 6 - The replacement extraction system should comprise a three-stage system to include a grease, pre and carbon filter. The duct should terminate one metre above eaves level or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises, whichever is the higher.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any elevation of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work and deliveries/removal of materials shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am to 6.00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8.00am to 12.00 noon on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - Informative:

The applicant is directed to the guidance given in the report to the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, dated May 2004 titled "Control of odour and noise from commercial kitchen exhaust systems" 

www.defra.gov.uk/environment/noise/research/kitchenexhaust/index. 

This report sets out standards to achieve good practice in commercial kitchens including minimum requirements for noise control, as well as details on what information is required to support a planning application for a commercial kitchen.
